decision: On a build the guard refuses (snapshot gated / BLOCKED), offer a raw zfs snapshot of EVERY managed volume of a STOPPED CT whose managed volumes are all on zfspool storage, plus a copy of the CT config, before BINDSNAP-UNSUPPORTED; anything else (running CT, a managed volume on non-ZFS storage) goes to vzdump.

evidence.text: Refusal text and order checked in lib/PVE/LXC/BindSnap.pm (snapshot_create: known-BAD die, then the snapshot gated die). RED (opus) on the pre-edit text listed as gaps: rootfs-only, no rollback, no config copy, unsure the route applies to a bind-mount CT. GREEN (opus, haiku) on the new text snapshotted rootfs and mp0 together, saved the config, routed an lvmthin rootfs to vzdump, and quoted the pct rollback interaction. ZFS and Proxmox behaviour itself is documented, not run on a node.

reopen_if: The overlay's own refusal starts offering a safe route itself, or Proxmox's ZFS plugin stops refusing a rollback past a newer snapshot.
why: The gate message offers only updating pve-container or the at-your-own-risk marker, and the pre-edit skill named only a rootfs (disk-0) zfs snapshot from its Not-for paragraph, with no mpN volumes, no config copy, no rollback, and no word on how a raw snapshot interacts with pct rollback.
